module_budget_change: Bump up the budget to 400 for now. There will be multiple PRs that will decrease the budget by 50. Each time the budget is hit you will make a change to decompose the files, until the budget of 250 is achieved. (maintainer, 2026-11-26)
description: holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json sets default_max_lines to 200 and freezes every module over 200 lines with an override at its current size. The maintainer has set a staged schedule: raise the default to 400 now, then lower it by 50 per pull request (350, 300, 250), decomposing the modules over each new limit, until 250 is reached.
goal: Step 1 of the schedule: set default_max_lines to 400 in holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json and remove every override whose value is at or below 400 (they are redundant under the new default). Keep every override above 400 exactly as it is (ratchet-down only; none raised or added). Keep the exclude list unchanged. Update the test that pins the 200-line default (apps/sandbox-executor/tests/flow/test_module_budgets.py) and the "Module line budgets" section of docs/architecture.md (the default_max_lines and overrides wording) so they reflect 400 and the staged schedule. Change no source module.
rationale: The 200-line default with dozens of frozen overrides forces splits on nearly every change; the maintainer chose a 400-line starting point that is lowered step by step with decomposition at each step.
acceptance_criteria: module_budgets.json has default_max_lines 400, no override at or below 400, every previous override above 400 unchanged, and the exclude list unchanged.
'uv run python scripts/check_module_budgets.py' passes on the PR head (with the module-budget-change label in CI).
The execution notes list the overrides removed (path and value), the overrides kept, and the number of modules between 351 and 400 lines (the next step's decomposition set).
No file under apps/*/src/ or scripts/ other than the listed scope changes.
All tests pass via 'uv run pytest', and 'uv run task lint' and 'uv run task lint-docs' pass.
